bib.title: SimVLM: Simple Visual Language Model Pretraining with Weak Supervision

question: Can a single prefix language modeling objective on raw image patches and weakly aligned web data replace detector-based, multi-loss vision-language pretraining?
hypothesis: Generative pretraining on large noisy image-text data, with no object detector or auxiliary losses, matches or beats MLM-based VLP and gives zero-shot transfer.
contributions: A minimalist VLP framework trained end-to-end with one PrefixLM objective
New SOTA on 6 VL benchmarks without extra data or task-specific customization
Zero-shot captioning, open-ended VQA and cross-modality transfer

method.summary: Encoder-decoder Transformer (ViT sizes) taking image patches via a 3-block ResNet conv stage as a bidirectional prefix, trained from scratch with prefix LM loss on text only, on ALIGN image-text pairs mixed with C4 text. Fine-tuned per task and also evaluated zero-shot.
method.task: vision-language pretraining with prefix language modeling

datasets.name: ALIGN
datasets.preprocessing: no filtering, simple random resized cropping only

datasets.name: WIT
datasets.preprocessing: 50k extra pretraining steps for zero-shot open-ended VQA demo

datasets.name: VQA v2
datasets.preprocessing: classification over 3,129 most frequent answers; also generative variant

models.name: SimVLM base
models.architecture: encoder-decoder Transformer, ViT-Base setting, ResNet-101 conv stage

models.name: SimVLM huge
models.architecture: ViT-Huge setting, larger ResNet-152 with more channels

models.name: VinVL, OSCAR, UNITER, Villa, UNIMO, SOHO, LXMERT, VL-T5

training.objective: single PrefixLM loss (Eq 3), loss on text tokens after prefix; prefix length Tp >= image length Ti
training.batch_size: 4,096 image-text pairs + 512 text-only documents per batch
training.regularisation: stochastic depth 0.1 (conv stage and encoder) in fine-tuning

other.finetune_image_resolution: 480x480 for VQA, positional params linearly interpolated
other.embedding_tying: embedding shared with decoder softmax output
other.shared_params: all shared across modalities except conv stage and positional embeddings
other.few_shot: fine-tune on 1% training data for 5 epochs

inference.samples: not stated; single run per number
inference.prompting: prefix prompt 'A picture of' for zero-shot captioning

metrics.name: vqa-score
metrics.definition: standard VQA accuracy; exact match of generated answers for generative VQA

metrics.name: Acc@1
metrics.definition: ImageNet linear evaluation on average-pooled encoder outputs

limits: No parameter counts, seeds, variance, wall-clock or FLOPs reported
Ablations use only a small 8-layer, 512-dim model and only VQA
Zero-shot VQA failed to give meaningful answers to real questions before 50k extra steps on WIT; evidence is qualitative
Zero-shot CoCo numbers were wrong in v1 and corrected in v3 (Appendix D erratum)
Exact-match scoring undercounts valid synonymous generated answers
ALIGN pretraining data release is not stated
